title: Momoi Airi — Together With Our Fans!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Classroom

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, let's do a debrief for our event from the other day!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Have you all come up with things that you need to work on moving forward?

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sure we'll overlap on a few things, so why don't we start with a quick rundown of what we have?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure, let's hear it. What do you feel needs improving from here on out?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, we all said that scrambling to get things set up wasn't good.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, why don't we start there?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I suppose we should think about what caused that all to happen, no?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, that seems pretty obvious.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We had a plan in terms of what to set up in which order, but didn't actually have a good idea of what the venue would be like.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That caused our staff to hesitate and even panic a little, so we need to make sure that doesn't happen again.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, the walkways in the hall were much narrower than we expected. We lost quite a bit of time having to move equipment through it as a one-way path.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we may've been able to prevent that if we had a chance to see the hall beforehand...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But it was booked solid until our event, so we couldn't...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We got to book this place because of a last-minute cancelation, so we sort of didn't have a choice but to do things on the fly.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So moving forward, we'll need to see how wide or accessible the entrances, exits, walkways, breezeways and all that stuff at the venues we book are.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, next we have... Not having a different leader present to answer questions when Saito is either busy or absent.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (We have so much to go over...)

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line:
That was really fun!
Seeing MORE MORE JUMP! live was so cool!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: I know, right? To be fair, I was pretty scared about what would happen after they started recruiting fans to work as staff... But everything went great!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line:
Yeah, I really want to see them again!
Maybe I'll join on as staff next time!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (They were all smiling at the end.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (A lot did happen, but we pulled together and succeeded. We need to take this experience and make sure our next event goes even better.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Besides, it wasn't all gloom and doom!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, that's everything we need to work on...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. So let's talk about what we did well!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! A lot happened, but it ended up being a big success!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, we're supposed to be talking specifics here.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For example, it was pretty miraculous how none of our instructions ended up conflicting with each other...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Conflicting instructions?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm talking about how some of the equipment could've been taken to different places depending on who said what, like the stage as opposed to the back lot.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think that has to do with how we exchanged information during our meeting prior to then.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly. I think we did a really good job planning out each step of the process and where we need to be careful.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I was impressed by that as well.
That meeting we had really helped illustrate what we needed to do.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I thought so too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: See what I mean? There's something else I think we achieved as well. Something pretty big.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh? What could that be?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We learned how to interact with the fans who decided to become our staff.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm not saying that we found the answer or anything like that, but I feel like we have a much better idea of what to do now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: On a personal level, I think we found a place of understanding and really learned to trust each other.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Trust...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. We're not friends or anything and they're sort of our employees, but we didn't have to be all that formal with one another.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We found a way to understand that we're after the same thing and that this event can only succeed if we work together.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If having mutual respect for each other means that they don't care how hard we have to work because they believe we'll dazzle them at the end, I want us to go after it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa! That'd be amazing!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But that also means we'll have to work even harder than before to actually achieve that!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi's right. If we can develop that sort of relationship with them, they might just be able to keep seeing us as idols.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, so we'll just have to keep doing everything we can to foster that wonderful bond!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, let's keep doing our best, together!
